clue.text: Fencing chum is dizzy, three parts dead

parts.note: a chum is a pal, a friend
taken as written

indicators.note: something dizzy is spinning and confused, so the letters it governs are jumbled
only three of the four letters of the word dead are kept, one D being dropped

explanation.surface: A friend is feeling faint and nearly dead after a fencing bout.
explanation.walkthrough: 'three parts' keeps three of the four letters of DEAD (DEA), which 'dizzy' scrambles to ADE.
explanation.definitionFit: A palisade is a fence of stakes, so it is fencing in the material sense.

clue.text: A shepherd who's after gold

parts.note: past means after, as in half past
or is the heraldic term for gold

explanation.surface: A shepherd is chasing riches.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastor is a minister who tends a flock of parishioners, the spiritual sense of shepherd.

clue.text: After dishonest action, blushing, returned the songs

indicators.note: the second piece follows the first

parts.note: telling a lie is a dishonest act

indicators.note: returned means the word for blushing goes back the other way

parts.note: a blushing face is red

explanation.surface: Having lied, someone blushed and gave back the songs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'returned' turns RED into DER, placed 'After' LIE.
explanation.definitionFit: Lieder are German art songs, such as those of Schubert.

clue.text: Drink wine to sustain

parts.note: to sup is to drink
port is a fortified wine

explanation.surface: A glass of wine keeps someone going.
explanation.definitionFit: To sustain something is to hold it up or bear its weight.

clue.text: Hospital treatment for a weak person

definitions.meaning: an intravenous line feeding fluid into a patient

explanation.definitionFit: Patients are put on an IV infusion, and a feeble, spineless person is also called a wet one in slang.

clue.text: Not drawn by the dentist at the end of play

definitions.meaning: teeth broken off but left in the gum rather than extracted
in cricket the close of a day's play is called by the removal of the wickets

explanation.definitionFit: Broken teeth left in the jaw are stumps; in cricket, close of play is called 'stumps' after the wooden posts of the wicket.

clue.text: Lifting lid and catch, right inside finds lock of hair

indicators.note: one letter is placed within the turned words
in a down clue lifting raises the words so they read upwards, from bottom to top

parts.note: taken as written
to net something is to catch it

explanation.surface: Raising a lid and a catch reveals a curl of hair inside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lifting' reverses LID and NET together, giving TEN DIL; 'inside' puts R within them.
explanation.definitionFit: A tendril is a slender curling strand, as of a vine or a wisp of hair.

clue.text: Think it might be teatime in Danish capital

indicators.note: the capital letter goes in among the rearranged letters
what the letters might be is a rearrangement of them
the capital or first letter of Danish

explanation.surface: Someone muses that it may be time for tea in Copenhagen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'capital' looks like Copenhagen but gives D, which goes 'in' a rearrangement of TEATIME.
explanation.definitionFit: To meditate is to reflect or ponder deeply.

clue.text: Observe key patient has natural form of protection

parts.note: to observe is to see
D is a musical key
a patient is a case to a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor sees that a patient has natural immunity.
explanation.definitionFit: A seedcase is the pod or capsule that shields seeds as they develop.

clue.text: Wash caused by vessel crossing the turbulent deep

indicators.note: the vessel goes across, spanning the other piece, so it holds it inside

parts.note: a ship is a vessel

indicators.note: turbulent water churns, so the letters of deep are churned up

explanation.surface: A ship's wake in rough seas causes a wash.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turbulent' rearranges DEEP to EEPD, which 'crossing' sets inside SHIP.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheep-dip is a chemical bath that farmers use to wash sheep against parasites.

clue.text: Keyed-up, reaching the border?

definitions.meaning: literally positioned at the edge of something

explanation.definitionFit: Being tense is idiomatically 'on edge', and something sitting at the very rim is literally there too.

clue.text: Progressive book hero

parts.note: the hero of Bunyan's allegory The ... Progress, whose title uses the word progress

explanation.definitionFit: Christian in Bunyan's allegory is the traveller to a holy place whose journey gives the book its title.

clue.text: Spotted beast in October — lion on the move

indicators.note: one piece sits inside the abbreviation for the month
moving the letters around signals they are rearranged

parts.note: Leo is the lion of the zodiac

explanation.surface: A lion is prowling about during October.
explanation.walkthrough: LEO (the zodiac lion) is rearranged by 'on the move' to ELO, then put 'in' OCT.
explanation.definitionFit: The ocelot is a wild cat of the Americas with a dappled, blotched coat.

clue.text: Loftier loft, it's said is the priest's property

definitions.note: an adjective meaning belonging to priests; the clue phrases it as a noun

indicators.note: speech is signalled, so the sound of the phrase gives the spelling

parts.note: a loftier loft is a higher attic

explanation.surface: A taller attic is said to belong to the priest.
explanation.walkthrough: HIGHER ATTIC spoken quickly sounds like the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Hieratic means relating to priests, as in the cursive script Egyptian priests used.

clue.text: Gets together and tucks in

definitions.meaning: in sewing, small pleats drawn together in fabric

explanation.definitionFit: Collecting people means assembling them, and a dressmaker's pleats pulled in on a thread share the name.

clue.text: When it goes off, a gun startles and blocks the airways

indicators.note: a gun going off scatters things, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A gunshot frightens people so much they can hardly breathe.
explanation.definitionFit: To strangle or constrict the throat is to cut off breathing, choking the windpipe.

clue.text: A formal defence of a sport head girl and I accepted

parts.note: polo is a sport played on horseback

indicators.note: the head of girl is its first letter

parts.note: taken as written
a is an abbreviation for accepted, used on bills of exchange

explanation.surface: A defence is offered by a sportswoman, the head girl and me.
explanation.walkthrough: A for 'accepted' is a banking abbreviation on bills of exchange.
explanation.definitionFit: An apologia is a written justification of one's beliefs, as in Newman's Apologia Pro Vita Sua.

clue.text: What the peace-maker aims to do may put us in jeopardy

parts.words: What the peace-maker aims to do
parts.note: a peace-maker tries to stop the fury: to finish it

parts.words: What the peace-maker aims to do
parts.note: the thing to be finished is rage or fury

explanation.surface: A mediator's efforts might put us at risk.
explanation.walkthrough: Read the answer as two words: what a peace-maker wants is to stop the fury.
explanation.definitionFit: To endanger is to expose to risk or threaten harm.

clue.text: Transporter can cope with ninth detour

indicators.note: a detour takes a roundabout route, so the letters go a different way round

explanation.surface: A removal van makes a ninth detour on its rounds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' just joins the two parts of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: A pantechnicon is a large furniture-removal lorry, a British term for a removals van.

clue.text: Clone he fashioned made the grade

indicators.note: fashioned means shaped anew, so the letters are formed into a new order

explanation.surface: A cloned man was made and passed the test.
explanation.definitionFit: An echelon is a rank or level in an organisation.

clue.text: Sort of joint supplying more than drink

parts.note: over means more than, as in over a hundred
to lap is to drink as a cat does

explanation.surface: A pub joint is serving more than drinks.
explanation.definitionFit: A lap joint, or overlap joint, is made by laying one piece over another in carpentry.

clue.text: To captivate men she writhes around

indicators.note: something that writhes twists about, so the letters twist into a new order

explanation.surface: A seductress twists around men to beguile them.
explanation.definitionFit: To enmesh is to entangle as in a net, so to ensnare or hold captive.

clue.text: Distant quarrelling of youngsters

definitions.note: the answer is a single litter, a group of young

parts.note: far means distant
a row is a quarrel

explanation.surface: Children are squabbling far away.
explanation.definitionFit: A farrow is a litter of piglets, a brood of young pigs.

clue.text: Tough, the early shift

indicators.note: shifting letters moves them into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: The early shift at work is a hard slog.
explanation.definitionFit: Leathery describes meat or skin as hard and chewy, like hide.

clue.text: The girl's in a struggle, getting strain injury

parts.note: her is the possessive for a girl

indicators.note: struggling letters wrestle into a new order

explanation.surface: A girl strains herself wrestling and gets hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: A hernia is a rupture where tissue pushes through muscle, often from lifting strain.

clue.text: That man's eating the fish skin!

indicators.note: the man takes the fish inside him

parts.note: he is that man, with the 's meaning is
id, also spelt ide, is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A man is eating fish skin and all.
explanation.definitionFit: A hide is an animal's pelt, the skin of a beast.

clue.text: Stare at city giant with deformed leg

parts.note: Gog is one of the two giants, Gog and Magog, who are traditional guardians of the City of London

indicators.note: a deformed shape is twisted, so these letters are twisted out of order

explanation.surface: People gawp at a giant with a misshapen leg.
explanation.walkthrough: Gog and Magog are giant figures in the City of London's Guildhall; 'deformed' turns LEG into GLE.
explanation.definitionFit: To goggle is to gape with wide eyes, staring openly.

clue.text: Plover seen to cause the death of some animals

parts.note: to cause the death of is to kill
deer are a kind of animal, and the plural is the same as the singular

explanation.surface: A bird watches some animals being killed.
explanation.definitionFit: The killdeer is a North American wading bird named for its piercing call.

clue.text: Worn by French maids on stages

definitions.meaning: pinafores tied over a maid's uniform
theatre platforms jutting out in front of the curtain

explanation.definitionFit: Maids wear pinafores over their dresses, and in theatres the forestage before the proscenium is also called by that name.

clue.text: Peeps who turn out for the entertainment

indicators.note: turning out the letters spills them into a fresh order

explanation.surface: Voyeurs come along to watch the show.
explanation.walkthrough: The page's 'Peers' cannot give the answer's second P; the anagram needs 'Peeps'.
explanation.definitionFit: A peepshow is a show viewed through a small hole, a kind of amusement or diversion.
